blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Tuesday that arresting Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who was last monitored in Mindanao, could lead to 10,000 deaths; thus, authorities continue to negotiate for his surrender. In an interview on Tuesday, Remulla said he received information two months ago that Dela Rosa is being protected by an “armed” group. He refused to provide further details regarding this group. “In exchange for hanggang 10,000 pwedeng mamatay, I would rather negotiate first than cost the lives of Filipinos in this,” Remulla said.
